decisions.reason: Only a brief website mention without a dedicated page signals limited commitment and low expected option value, so the firm likely abandons this option.
A dedicated page indicates active marketing and the electric panel segment still has uncertain but potentially valuable demand, so the option is kept open.
The halogen infrared heater targets a niche that may resolve favorably, and its own page suggests the firm is gathering market feedback, so the option remains open.
Industrial hall heating has clear application value and the product's own page indicates commitment, making abandonment unlikely while uncertainty remains manageable.
Hydrogen-capable technology holds strategic real option value and the successful real-operation launch reduces technical uncertainty, so the firm keeps this option for future hydrogen adoption.
